name: Sour Smash Gummies | 200mg
description: A chill take on a sour classic, Sour Smash Gummies are an assorted-flavor pack that features super sour coatings on a medley of three sour fruit flavors. Perfect for those Hybrid days when you want to sour smash and then chill.
